thread:
Carla (Support): FYI client 'ClientX' opened a severity-2 ticket — reporting p95 latency jump from ~220ms -> 1.2s since last night. They say it started ~00:45 UTC after our scheduled model maintenance.
Ben (SRE): Thanks. Do we have correlation with deploys/rollouts?
Carla (Support): @deploy-bot shows a model variant rollout at 00:37 UTC: quantized-8bit v2 -> routed to dedicated pool cx-dedicated-1. Ticket includes sample req_id=cx-req-9a1b.
deploy-bot: deployment: quantized-8bit-v2 promoted to pool cx-dedicated-1 at 2026-03-19T00:37:12Z by CI.
Dmitri (Runtime): I pushed a kernel/quantization micro-optim last night that changed per-token kernel selection for short sequences — possible perf regression on Ampere. Rolling back now to compare.
Frank (Oncall): Collecting traces and perf counters. @Ben can you confirm if autoscaler bumped GPU tasks?
Ben (SRE): Autoscaler didn't change. But we see high GPU utilization >95% on cx-dedicated-1, concurrent sessions up 2.4x. Could be batching behavior changed post-quant.
Carla (Support): Customer reports throughput drop too — from 450 rps -> ~180 rps for their steady test. SLA at risk. Emily (Sales): Client is in renewal window next week, flagged as high priority by AM.
Alice (PM): Need quick mitigation plan. Options: 1) rollback quantized-8bit-v2 to previous variant, 2) route ClientX traffic to float16 pool temporarily, 3) increase capacity for their pool. Thoughts?
Dmitri (Runtime): Quick check: enabling old kernel path restores per-token time locally. Patch rolling back quant kernel now. Will monitor.
Ben (SRE): I can add immediate temporary routing rule to send clientX->float16-pool. That should reduce p95 but costs more. Want me to flip?
Alice (PM): Do it. Also we need a postmortem checklist: reproduce, root cause, perf regression test in CI, canary strategy update.
Frank (Oncall): Flipped routing at 01:05 UTC. Observed p95 drop to ~270ms within 2min, throughput back to ~420 rps. Client confirmed via ticket. :thumbsup:
Carla (Support): Client acknowledges improvement. They want ETA for permanent fix and assurance it won't happen on other pools.
Dmitri (Runtime): Root cause initial hypothesis: new quant kernel selects larger micro-batches for short sequences leading to higher tail latency under their workload distribution. Repro steps I used locally: 
```
# repro (local quick test)
python perf_runner.py --model quantized-8bit-v2 --seq 32 --concurrency 40 --duration 120
# observe p95
```
I'll add a unit/bench test to CI and a guard in runtime to avoid the problematic kernel selection for seq<=64.
Ben (SRE): I'll add an alert on kernel-selection latency anomaly and create a fallback route in router for affected model variants.
Emily (Sales): I'll tell AMs we rolled back traffic and are patching; please share ETA before EOD.
Alice (PM): Proposed scope: hotfix rollback + safety guard (short-term) -> 1d; CI perf test + canary policy update -> 3d; long-term kernel tuning -> 2w. Approve?
Dmitri (Runtime): Agree with scope/timeline. I'll open an RFC and link to this thread.
Ben (SRE): Ticket created: INF-4521 "quant-kernel regressions: ClientX incident". Assignments: Dmitri (owner), Ben (routing/alerts), Frank (oncall follow-up), Carla (customer comms).
Carla (Support): Added client note, sent interim update.
Frank (Oncall): Postmortem will capture decision matrix for routing vs rollback for future quant experiments.
Alice (PM): Ok. Emily — please flag renewal stakeholders and confirm they're satisfied with mitigation.
Emily (Sales): Will do.
Carla (Support): Closing loop: ticket state -> monitoring; marking incident resolved for now pending root cause work.
Dmitri (Runtime): Pushing PR for guard and local tests now: https://git.internal/r/redwood/runtime/pulls/824 (WIP).
Ben (SRE): I'll schedule a canary run of quantized-8bit-v2 against a small percentage and watch the kernel-selection metric.
Carla (Support): Thanks team — client updated to "watching" and asked for weekly updates until patch is in prod.
Frank (Oncall): Logging action items in INF-4521. If anyone sees recurrence ping me directly.
Alice (PM): Good triage. We'll reconvene after Dmitri's PR lands.
